Publish makes all the paperwork of the show in one go. Click Publish in the toolbar.
It works in four steps: what, content, look and publish. On the right is a preview, and it shows the real pages: the same pages that end up in the PDF.
Step one is what to publish. Choose the DB's, all of them or only one, and tick the documents.
The total DB book has a cover, a contents page with page numbers, and every section you choose. The eye shows a document in the preview.
The IP address book lists every address of the nodes, the switches and the consoles, per DB, per VLAN, and sorted by number. Double addresses turn red.
LK info and node info are one file for every DB. And the stickers: one on every node, with its IP address, VLAN, switch port and universes, and one on every switch.
The A three network flow draws the network and the signal flow of every DB, on a big sheet, with the orientation that fits best.
Step two is the content. Switch sections on or off, and drag them to change the order. The small labels show where a section is used.
Click a part of the preview to jump to its settings. The orange handle puts a section at a fixed place on the sheet.
Step three is the look. Portrait is the default. Choose the colours, the line weight, and the header and footer, with page numbers on every page.
On the logos tab, upload your project logo and your company logo. Both are put on every page, where you want them.
Step four is publish. Choose a folder, and keep create a folder structure on.
PatchLab makes a folder with the project name, a folder for every DB with LK info, node info and a stickers folder, an A three folder, the book, and the IP address book.
The big button makes all the files in one go, and opens the folder when it is done.
One button, one folder, and everything is up to date. Publish again after every change.
